name: Obsidian Memory & Vault Integration
description: Full autonomous integration with your local Obsidian vault to create notes, rewrite and reorder facts, search notes, teach workflows, and manage memory with [[wikilinks]].

tools.name: obsidian_create_note
tools.description: Create a new Markdown note in the Obsidian vault under a specified category (e.g. Daily, Projects, Preferences, Learned, Profile, Instructions, Research).

category.description: Category or folder in the vault (e.g. Daily, Projects, Preferences, Learned, Instructions, Research)

tools.name: obsidian_rewrite_note
tools.description: Rewrite, update, or reorganize an existing note in the Obsidian vault to correct outdated facts, optimize knowledge, or reorder content.

category.description: Category folder (e.g. Preferences, Learned, Profile, Projects, Instructions, Research)

content.description: New updated markdown content replacing old facts

tools.name: obsidian_teach
tools.description: Teach ALIEN a custom procedure, workflow, preference, or behavioral rule. Persists cleanly into Instructions/<Title>.md.

title.description: Title of the taught rule or procedure

instructions.description: Detailed step-by-step instructions or rules taught by the user

tools.name: obsidian_append_note
tools.description: Append timestamped content or an insight to an existing Obsidian note.

category.description: Category folder (e.g. Daily, Projects, Preferences, Learned)

content.description: Text or bullet points to append

tools.name: obsidian_read_note
tools.description: Read the text content of a note from the Obsidian vault.

category.description: Category folder (optional, will search all if omitted)

tools.name: obsidian_search_notes
tools.description: Search for keywords or topics across all markdown notes in the Obsidian vault.

tools.name: obsidian_list_notes
tools.description: List all notes and their categories currently in the Obsidian vault.

tools.name: obsidian_vault_status
tools.description: Returns current Obsidian vault path, connection state, and note counts.
